ajohnson: spotted a ~9% token overcount in vendor export vs our ledger for promo tenants. Vendor rows show `ratecap_apportioned` > `ingest_tokens`. Suspect replay duplication.

maria-ops: paste a redacted sample row?

ajohnson: `ACME-123,2026-02-01T00:00Z,120000,132000` (vendor CSV).

liam: are these from dedupe-v3?

ajohnson: vendor claims yes. ledger shows 120k. Opening vendor ticket now.

finance-bot: quick totals: internal=1,200,000, vendor=1,320,000. Top deltas flagged with header `x-proxy-replay:true`.

sara: invoice run Tue. Recommend holding invoices for affected tenants under threshold?

maria-ops: propose hold <= $5k and prepare credit memo template in case vendor concedes.

legal: contract Clause 4.2: "Replay events for delivery guarantees shall not be billable." Copying into vendor ticket will help.

liam: found a TODO in `ratecap_apportioner` re: retries. I'll add telemetry to correlate `replay_id` across edge -> billing -> vendor export. ETA EOD.

ajohnson: vendor ticket #VND-4521 created with samples and contract clause. Vendor SLA 48h.

sara: approved: auto-hold invoices <= $5k. Pre-approve credits <= $2k; >$2k needs manager sign-off. I'll update billing run notes.

maria-ops: action items: 1) ajohnson follow vendor; 2) liam add telemetry + triage code path; 3) finance to hold per threshold. Update thread when vendor replies.
